channel.title: Freedom Foundation – Bias and Credibility - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Freedom Foundation – Bias and Credibility (freedomfoundation.com)

item.title: WASHINGTON: It’s about giving workers options - Freedom Foundation
item.description: Public sector unions are not just workplace representatives; they’re powerful political actors with influence that extends across ballot initiatives, elected officials, nonprofit organizations and super PACs.

item.title: CALIFORNIA: Union hubris in any language - Freedom Foundation
item.description: After Freedom Foundation’s National Canvassing Director Dustin James reported that Spanish-speaking union represented workers were being taken advantage of, I knew I had to go down and see it for myself.

item.title: Idaho ends taxpayer support for teachers' unions - Freedom Foundation
item.description: Idaho Gov. Brad Little on April 10 signed into law a Freedom Foundation-supported measure crafted to end taxpayer support for teachers' unions in the Gem State.

item.title: What Unions Were Meant to Be — And What They’ve Become, A Story of Self Destruction - Freedom Foundation
item.description: Unions were created with a simple mission to perform: Protecting workers. Standing in between employees and abuse.

item.title: Double standards in Pueblo 70: Union power, taxpayer dollars and selective outrage - Freedom Foundation
item.description: After weeks of intense public pressure, including loud demands from union supporters, the Pueblo County School District 70 board approved a generous extension of its collective bargaining agreement with the Pueblo County Education Association.

item.title: VIDEO: Utah Teachers' Union Caught Lying About Political Spending - Freedom Foundation
item.description: In a video released today by the Freedom Foundation, Cole Kelley, a public school teacher of 29 years and member of the Utah State Board of Education, exposes the Utah Education Association's false claims that members’ dues are not used for political activities.

item.title: Freedom Foundation Appeals Dismissal of Lawsuit Challenging Oregon ‘Anti-Impersonation’ Law - Freedom Foundation
item.description: The Freedom Foundation today appealed to the 9th Circuit Court of Appeals after a district court judge last week dismissed its case challenging Oregon HB 3789.

item.title: MINNESOTA: Workers heading for the exits - Freedom Foundation
item.description: For six straight months, more than 100 Minnesota public employees a month have cut ties with their unions.

item.title: Florida Education Association Ordered to Pay Teacher's Legal Fees After Unfair Labor Practice Ruling - Freedom Foundation
item.description: Florida’s Public Employees Relations Commission (PERC) has ruled against the Florida Education Association in an unfair labor practice case, ordering the union to cover attorney fees and litigation costs for retired Martin County teacher Kelley LaBedz. item.title: What Three Years of Canvassing at UCLA Taught Me About Unions - Freedom Foundation
item.description: For the past three years, my team and I have spent hundreds of hours on the UCLA campus talking to union-represented employees.

item.title: CALIFORNIA: Record opt-out numbers as 2026 debuts - Freedom Foundation
item.description: California public employees are continuing to exercise their right to decline union membership and dues in huge numbers.

item.title: 9th Circuit Case Against UTLA Fully Briefed, Awaiting Oral Argument - Freedom Foundation
item.description: The Freedom Foundation filed a reply brief with the 9th Circuit Court of Appeals on behalf of seven Jewish Los Angeles public school teachers challenging a California law under which they have no choice in being represented by a union with a well-documented record of anti-Jewish and anti-Zionist conduct.

item.title: Oklahoma Passes Bills to Level Playing Field for Educator Organizations - Freedom Foundation
item.description: The Freedom Foundation today applauded the passage of two measures through the Oklahoma Legislature that would guarantee equal access for all organizations seeking to communicate with public school employees, breaking the stranglehold teachers’ unions have long held over educator outreach in the state.

item.title: Oregon public employees still opting out despite anti-Freedom Foundation legislation - Freedom Foundation
item.description: Notwithstanding the best efforts of Big Labor and its allies in elected office to stifle opposition and restrict access to information, Oregon public-sector employees are still choosing to leave their unions in healthy numbers.

item.title: Ending Taxpayer Support for Union Activity in Florida - Freedom Foundation
item.description: A new Freedom Foundation report documents how Florida's government unions have long benefited from tens-of-millions of dollars in taxpayer support. While recent legislation takes big strides towards ending union subsidies in the Sunshine State, more remains to be done.
